description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D1_periodic driven by problems/advection_1d_periodic_central.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)) is transported without shape change; the centered scheme is non-dissipative, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure dispersive spatial-discretization error, expected to fall as O(dx^2).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
